source: Made for this study (not a tau-bench task), on tau-bench's airline data
why_chosen: A short, read-only task for real LLMs, the airline twin of retail-status: 2 tool calls (check the customer's profile, read the reservation), no data changes, and an exact answer to check. Few LLM calls, so it stays within free-tier API rate limits.
goal: A customer with user id harper_garcia_8677 asks about their reservation 7IG5PW: which cabin class is it booked in, and how much did they pay for it? Only look this up; do not change anything.
